title: Implement RBAC epoch anchors, audit-replay protector, and KMS usage metering
author: Leah Park
release_notes: Adds RBAC epoch anchors for deterministic role evaluation, a middleware to detect and reject replayed audit streams, and KMS usage metering with Prometheus metrics. Backwards compatible; rollout behind feature flag.
description: Context & motivation: We have seen intermittent incidents where delayed or duplicated operator requests led to inconsistent RBAC decisions across replicas (notably during leader failovers), and audit ingestion replay caused duplicated audit rows in downstream sinks. At the same time we lack fine-grained KMS metering by tenant which hampers billing accuracy for Private/Dedicated customers. This PR introduces three coordinated features: 1) RBAC epoch anchors: a small, cheap epoch token attached to role bindings so decision caches can detect stale evaluation state across operators; 2) Audit-replay protector: server-side middleware that uses the audit event anchor and a short-term sliding window to detect and reject duplicate audit events (with a configurable grace window and de-dup key derivation); 3) KMS usage metering: per-tenant counters and Prometheus exposition for number of KMS wraps/unlocks and total bytes encrypted, with conservative sampling for high-throughput tenants. Design summary: - RBAC epoch anchors are represented as a single 64-bit monotonic epoch appended to role binding objects; evaluators check the anchor against a small in-memory per-principal cache and force re-evaluation when mismatch occurs. Anchors are updated on binding changes and are cheap to diff. - The audit-replay protector computes a replay-key (sha256 of {tenant, event_type, event_id, epoch}) and stores a short-lived bloom filter + LRU-backed map; duplicates within the configured window are rejected with HTTP 409 and an audit header "X-Audit-Replay-Detected" set. - KMS meter runs as middleware around KMS driver calls and increments tenant-scoped counters. We opted for eventual consistency for counters and expose Prometheus metrics in a new kube-metrics job. API & config changes: - New feature flags: feature.rbac_epoch_anchors (default OFF), feature.audit_replay_protector (default ON for hosted), feature.kms_metering (default OFF). - New config options under security.* to tune epoch TTL, audit replay window (default 5m), KMS sampling rate (default 1.0). - New API: GET /admin/kms-metrics?tenant_id= (admin-only) to fetch aggregated counters (paginated). Rollout plan: - Merge to main gated behind feature flags. - Canary: enable rbac_epoch_anchors only for control-plane-canary and two small tenants; enable kms_metering for observability tenants only. - Monitor: dashboard with replay detector rates, RBAC re-eval spikes, KMS meter counters; revert path documented below. Testing: - Unit tests for epoch anchor diffing and decision cache invalidation. - Integration tests simulate leader failover and ensure consistent decisions. - E2E for audit ingestion: inject duplicate events and assert duplicates are detected. - Load eval: KMS metering sampling verified under 10k req/s. Checklist: - [x] Data model migration for epoch anchors (no DB lock required; atomic per-binding write) - [x] Backwards compatibility tests with older operators (epoch absent => behave as before) - [x] Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboard panels - [x] Docs: security/rbac_epoch_anchors.md and ops/runbooks/audit-replay.md - [x] Linear stories linked: ENG-420, ENG-421 Related: SUP-1123 (support ticket with repro of duplicate audit rows). Notes & caveats: - We intentionally keep epoch as non-authoritative: if a binding change happens concurrently, a mismatched epoch forces a fresh evaluation that may briefly increase latency for the affected call. This is preferable to silent inconsistent allows/denies. - Audit replay protector may reject late-but-unique events if they collide on replay-key; collision window and key composition are tunable and multiple strategies (strict vs lenient) are supported by config. - KMS metering uses an in-memory buffer flushed to the metric exporter to avoid extra DB writes; therefore counts are eventually consistent and likely slight undercounts in crash scenarios. Migration & compatibility: - No migrations that block deploys. Operators without epoch-support see no behavior change. - Admin API gated behind admin role and logged in audit stream. See release notes for monitoring queries and rollback steps.

Leah Park (2025-02-13): Added env config and replay_rejects_total counter; updated dashboard JSON in docs.

merge_notes: Canary rollout started; feature.rbac_epoch_anchors enabled for control-plane-canary and two tenants. KMS metering disabled by default for Dedicated until billing hookup. Ops notified via runbook link.
rollback_plan: Disable feature flags, remove epoch checks from config and restart canaries. For audit replay false-positives set replay window to lenient mode and re-ingest rejected events via support path documented in ops/runbooks/audit-replay.md.
observability_queries: grafana: (panel) Audit: replay rejects per tenant - sum(rate(audit_replay_rejects_total[5m])) by (tenant)
